description:
`dev/index.md` describes a bucket layout the overhaul removes. It is rewritten to describe the final `dev/` top level so contributors place new material correctly.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `dev/index.md` describes each remaining `dev/` top-level entry: epic directories under `active/`, container archives and the legacy mirror under `archive/`, and each operational directory with its consumers.
- [hard] REQ-02: The `dev/` top level contains no `plans`, `presentations` or `sessions` directory and no other obsolete documentation bucket.
- [hard] REQ-03: `dev/index.md` and `dev/authoring-conventions.md` contain no link to a removed path, and their links resolve.
title: Rewrite dev/index.md for the final dev layout
